title: Parking grace period
naturalLanguageRequirements: A parking stay ends when the vehicle leaves. The source text does not say whether the driver has a grace period after the paid end time.
informalMarkdown:
# Functions

## Close a stay

The meter closes a stay when the vehicle leaves the bay. Whether time after the paid end is forgiven is not stated.

# Data Resources

## Stay

The stay records the bay, the paid end time, and the departure time.

# Constraints

## Paid time

The driver pays for the time from arrival until the paid end time.

unresolvedSlots.question: Is there a grace period after the paid end time?

alternatives.label: A vehicle may leave within 10 minutes of the paid end time without a further charge.
Charges continue until the vehicle leaves, and there is no grace period.

unresolvedSlots.clarificationTarget: Whether departure after the paid end time has a grace period, and how long it is.
